name: Endings of the 2020s
description: Hand-picked: what reached its official end in this decade, from Flash and Internet Explorer to Python 2 and Windows 10.
author: codegrave

checkpoints.name: The great switch-off
checkpoints.note: Three years in which long-dying technology is finally turned off: Python 2 and Flash in 2020, Silverlight and AngularJS in 2021, Internet Explorer in 2022.
